info.name: Harmony BMS - Post-Disaster Land Rights & Relief API
info.description: Complete REST API collection for Team Harmony BMS (BMS College of Engineering 24-Hour Buildathon 2026). Covers all 14 endpoints across land registration, geospatial overlap detection, community attestation, dispute arbitration, disaster relief schemes, field damage assessment, and dual-officer payout release on MST Blockchain Testnet.

request.description: Submits a new land parcel claim. Hashes owner and evidence, triggers on-chain creation via chain.createClaim(), runs Turf.js geospatial overlap check, and persists claim to MongoDB Atlas with initial status 'Pending'.

item.name: 1.2 POST /claims (Create Overlapping Claim -> Auto Dispute Demo)

request.description: Demonstrates automated boundary conflict detection. Turf.js detects 42% overlap with Parcel #1, automatically triggers chain.dispute(), routes claim status to 'Disputed', and freezes payouts.
Fetches all registered parcels with GeoJSON polygons, trust scores, and statuses for rendering interactive Leaflet map markers.
Fetches parcel details by on-chain claimId, merging off-chain MongoDB Atlas document with immutable on-chain state read from chain.getClaim().
Pre-flight endpoint used by the React frontend while a citizen or surveyor is drawing a polygon. Returns collision percentage and conflicting parcel details before submission.

Submits a trust-weighted attestation. Role weights: Neighbor (+1), Village Leader (+3), Accredited NGO (+3). When cumulative score reaches >= 5, claim automatically transitions from 'Pending' to 'Verified'.
Flags a claim for human arbitration. Triggers chain.dispute() on-chain and updates claim status to 'Disputed'.
Authorized government arbiter resolves a disputed claim. If restore is true, resets status to 'Verified'; if false, reverts to 'Pending'.
Returns all currently disputed claims for display in the Government Dispute Resolver mediation dashboard.

Public certificate endpoint linked from QR codes. Performs an on-the-fly SHA-256 evidence integrity re-hash, validates against stored evidenceHash, and displays claim status, attestations, and payout record.
Declares a relief scheme. Computes 0x-prefixed zoneHash bytes32, saves relief parameters to MongoDB Atlas, and bridges on-chain via chain.createRelief().
Lists all active disaster relief schemes, zone boundaries, rate per acre, and remaining budget.

Filters Verified + non-Disputed claims within the relief polygon via isEligible(). Computes damageLevel and amount for assessed claims (amount '0' and status 'None' for unassessed), and scales all claims using scaleToBudget so total payouts never exceed escrowed budget.
Accredited assessor evaluates damage using standard criteria. Evaluates score -> damageLevel (1..4) and calculates compensation amount in wei using pure BigInt arithmetic.
Government relief officer approves assessed payout. When 2 unique officers approve, status advances from 'Assessed' to 'Approved'.
Releases approved payout. Freezes if claim is Disputed. Marks status as 'Paid', logs MST transaction hash, and deducts amount from relief scheme's remainingBudget.
Returns payout record for claimId. Status is guaranteed to be one of: None | Assessed | Approved | Paid, with amount in wei.
